FINDING_ID: Codex_R1_F001  
SEVERITY: 0.83  
FLAW_CLASS: 1  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.48  
DESCRIPTION: `reassign()` accepts `round_idx` and its own comments define the penalty as `phi_hist(m, r-1)`, but the method never uses `round_idx`, and `_failure_history` stores only an append-only `List[bool]` with no round keys. That makes the penalty temporally ambiguous: current-round failures can leak into the current reassignment if they are recorded before `reassign()`, skipped rounds shrink the denominator, and duplicate `record_failure()` calls in one round overweight that round. The result is that COL reassignment can depend on call order rather than round state.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Store failure history by round, not by raw append order, for example `Dict[str, Dict[int, bool]]`; make `record_failure()` take `round_idx`; compute `phi_hist` only from rounds `< round_idx`; reject duplicate writes for the same model/round.  
VERIFIED: TRUE

FINDING_ID: Codex_R1_F002  
SEVERITY: 0.72  
FLAW_CLASS: 2  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.54  
DESCRIPTION: `reassign()` silently mixes time bases when `live_fingerprints` is partial. For any model ID missing from the provided dict, it falls back to the original fingerprint from `_models`, not the last known live state and not an error. That means a single reassignment can compare one model using round-current data against another using initial estimates, which can change COL selection for reasons unrelated to actual capability.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Require `live_fingerprints` to cover all active models, or persist the last known live fingerprint per model inside `RoleAssignment` and use that as the fallback instead of the initial fingerprint. Fail fast if the provided live set is incomplete and no persisted live value exists.  
VERIFIED: TRUE

FINDING_ID: Codex_R1_F003  
SEVERITY: 0.66  
FLAW_CLASS: 1  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.44  
DESCRIPTION: `get_ordering()` always returns every model in `capability_scores`, even after reassignment has reduced the active set. This means inactive or failed models remain present in the published ordering and can still appear ahead of active ones. This is distinct from the stale-score defect already identified: even if scores were refreshed correctly, the method would still expose inactive IDs unless it filters them.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Add an active-only ordering path, either by filtering to `self.role_map.keys()` or by accepting an explicit `active_models` argument; if a full historical ordering is still needed, expose that as a separate method so callers cannot confuse the two.  
VERIFIED: TRUE

FINDING_ID: Codex_R1_F004  
SEVERITY: 0.58  
FLAW_CLASS: 5  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.71  
DESCRIPTION: Potential cross-component divergence: Role Assignment keeps its own boolean `_failure_history`, while Area 6 exposes a separate typed failure ledger via `FailureHandler.get_failure_history(model_id) -> List[FailureRecord]`. From the provided scope there is no verified synchronization path between them. If both exist independently, the COL penalty can drift away from the system’s authoritative failure state, especially when failures are classified, retried, or suppressed elsewhere.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Make Role Assignment consume a single shared failure source from Failure Handling, or inject a round-indexed failure summary into `reassign()` instead of maintaining a second local history store.  
VERIFIED: FALSE
